theme: Human Dignity & Household Security / Better World
launch_geography: US county / metro preferred at launch → expand to state / national / comparable international

indicators.name: Food burden (% income)
indicators.definition: Share of median household income required for a standardized food basket (fast-food / grocery proxy). Launch uses restaurant basket × frequency / annual MHI.
indicators.best_source: BLS CPI food; USDA ERS food-at-home; local basket scrapes (restaurant-inflation / cost-of-living pilots)
indicators.geography: US metro / state (24 metros, 19 states wired); county expansion planned
indicators.caveats: Basket composition and eating-out frequency are proxies, not full household food budgets. Cross-metro menu coverage is uneven.
indicators.politicians_may_falsely_claim_credit_by: Claiming credit for national CPI dips while local basket prices stay high; attributing grocery relief to a single bill without controlling for energy, wages, or global commodity shocks.

indicators.name: Energy (electricity + gas) burden (% income)
indicators.definition: Estimated monthly residential electricity (and gasoline where available) cost as % of median household income at fixed usage assumptions (e.g., 900 kWh/mo; gallons/mo for driving).
indicators.best_source: EIA electric sales/revenue by state; EIA gasoline; Census ACS/SAIPE income
indicators.geography: US state (51 jurisdictions for electricity as of 2026-06); metro overlays where available
indicators.caveats: Fixed kWh ignores climate, housing stock, and rate design. Gas coverage incomplete in some exports. Burden ≠ retail rate alone.
indicators.politicians_may_falsely_claim_credit_by: Citing a rate freeze while fixed charges rise; blaming the other party for weather-driven peaks; taking credit for cheap hydro/nuclear sited decades earlier.

indicators.name: Rent / housing burden
indicators.definition: Share of household income spent on rent or owner costs (classic 30%+ burden threshold), plus severe burden (50%+).
indicators.best_source: HUD CHAS; ACS median gross rent / income; Zillow Observed Rent Index as supplemental price signal
indicators.caveats: Rent indexes are not identical to tenant burden. Vacancy, quality, and household size matter. Owner costs differ from renter burdens.
indicators.politicians_may_falsely_claim_credit_by: Announcing unit production without affordability covenants; citing citywide median rent while excluding newly gentrified tracts; taking credit for pandemic eviction pauses that expired.

indicators.name: Child poverty
indicators.definition: Share of children under 18 in households below the official or supplemental poverty measure.
indicators.best_source: Census SAIPE (county); Census CPS/ASEC SPM for national; Kids Count
indicators.caveats: Official poverty vs SPM diverge. Small-area estimates have margins of error. Immigration and undercount affect some counties.
indicators.politicians_may_falsely_claim_credit_by: Claiming poverty 'ended' from a temporary tax credit that expired; using national averages to hide high-poverty counties; cherry-picking post-recession mean reversion.

indicators.name: Preventable mortality / primary care access (proxy)
indicators.definition: Amenable mortality and/or primary-care physician / clinic access rates as dignity-relevant health security proxies.
indicators.best_source: CDC WONDER; HRSA Area Health Resources Files; Commonwealth Fund state scorecards
indicators.caveats: Mortality lags policy. Rural hospital closures confound access. Race and age standardization required for fair comparison.
indicators.politicians_may_falsely_claim_credit_by: Taking credit for long-run mortality declines driven by medical technology; blaming opponents for pandemic excess deaths without age structure; announcing clinics without staffing.

indicators.name: Violent crime victimization
indicators.definition: Violent victimization rates (preferably NCVS) and/or homicide rates with clear source hierarchy — survey victimization preferred over arrests for harm-to-persons framing.
indicators.best_source: BJS NCVS; FBI UCR/NIBRS (with coverage caveats); CDC NVSS for homicide
indicators.geography: US national / large metro; county where reliable
indicators.caveats: NIBRS transition creates breaks. Clearance ≠ incidence. Small cities swing wildly year to year.
indicators.politicians_may_falsely_claim_credit_by: Citing a single-year drop as proof of a policy; comparing non-comparable UCR eras; using 'crime is down' nationally while ignoring homicide spikes in specific neighborhoods.

indicators.name: Homelessness rate
indicators.definition: Point-in-time sheltered + unsheltered persons per 10,000 residents; chronic homelessness share.
indicators.best_source: HUD Point-in-Time / HIC; local Continuum of Care reports
indicators.caveats: PIT undercounts hidden homelessness. Weather and one-night methods bias. Housing first vs shelter capacity debates need separate process measures.
indicators.politicians_may_falsely_claim_credit_by: Clearing encampments without exits to housing; counting shelter beds as 'solved'; claiming credit for federal Emergency Housing Vouchers while cutting local zoning reform.

indicators.name: Wage purchasing power / real median income
indicators.definition: Inflation-adjusted median household or worker earnings; optionally wage vs local price index.
indicators.best_source: Census ACS/CPS real median income; BLS CPI / regional price parities; BEA RPP
indicators.caveats: Median ≠ typical for multi-earner households. Regional price parity imperfect. Stock wealth ≠ wage power.
indicators.politicians_may_falsely_claim_credit_by: Citing nominal wage growth during high inflation; attributing national income gains to a local tax cut; ignoring composition effects from out-migration of low-income households.

indicators.name: Corruption / transparency proxy
indicators.definition: Composite of public integrity indicators: FOIA timeliness, conviction/ethics enforcement rates, open-budget scores — framed as transparency capacity, not a smear index.
indicators.best_source: Transparency International CPI (national); state FOIA audits; DOJ public integrity statistics (careful interpretation)
indicators.caveats: Conviction counts reflect enforcement effort as much as corruption. Cross-country CPI is perception-based. Local data sparse.
indicators.politicians_may_falsely_claim_credit_by: Passing 'ethics reform' that weakens inspectors general; touting low conviction counts as cleanliness rather than weak prosecution; weaponizing corruption talk against opponents while stonewalling FOIA.

indicators.name: Peaceful transfer / election integrity proxy
indicators.definition: Process indicators for peaceful transfer and election administration: certification timelines, audit completion, poll access, and documented interference attempts — not 'which party won.'
indicators.best_source: MIT Election Data + Science Lab; CISA; state election director reports; Varieties of Democracy (V-Dem) electoral components for cross-national
indicators.geography: US state / national; V-Dem for international context
indicators.caveats: Integrity ≠ preferred outcome. Access and security can trade off in rhetoric — measure both. Avoid partisan 'stolen election' framing.
indicators.politicians_may_falsely_claim_credit_by: Equating victory with integrity; equating loss with fraud; expanding or restricting access rules solely for partisan advantage while calling it 'security' or 'equity.'

indicators.name: Religious liberty / conscience freedom index
indicators.definition: Cite existing global indices carefully (e.g., Pew Government Restrictions / Social Hostilities; USCIRF tiers; V-Dem religion freedom components). US state layer uses statute + court outcomes, not vibes.
indicators.best_source: Pew GR/SHI; USCIRF annual; V-Dem; Becket / SCOTUSblog case trackers for US doctrine (supplemental)
indicators.geography: National (global indices) → US state case/statute layer
indicators.caveats: Indices mix government restriction and social hostility. US debates often conflate establishment, free exercise, and antidiscrimination — keep categories distinct. Nonsectarian framing: conscience for all, not one tradition.
indicators.politicians_may_falsely_claim_credit_by: Claiming to defend 'religious liberty' while targeting disfavored minorities; claiming 'neutrality' while selectively enforcing zoning against houses of worship; exporting culture-war wins as universal freedom.

indicators.name: Environmental burden on poor communities
indicators.definition: Exposure of low-income / historically marginalized tracts to air toxics, flood risk, heat, and proximity to polluting facilities.
indicators.best_source: EPA EJScreen; CDC/ATSDR environmental justice indexes; FEMA flood hazard + ACS income overlay
indicators.caveats: Screening tools are not individualized risk assessments. Facility proximity ≠ exposure dose. Climate projections carry uncertainty bands.
indicators.politicians_may_falsely_claim_credit_by: Announcing a plant closure after emissions already fell under prior rules; citing statewide air averages while fenceline communities worsen; greenlining investment away from the poor and calling it climate action.
